name: Apollo 11
summary: First crewed landing on the Moon. Left the Eagle descent stage and the first surface experiment package at Tranquility Base.

name: Apollo 14
summary: Landing in the Fra Mauro highlands; deployed the first ALSEP station to run through the lunar night.

name: Apollo 15
summary: First mission with the Lunar Roving Vehicle and the first extended geological traverses at Hadley-Apennine.

name: Apollo 16
summary: Descartes highlands mission that carried the first astronomical observatory to another world.

name: Apollo 17
summary: The last crewed lunar landing. Taurus-Littrow, the longest traverses and the largest sample return.

name: Surveyor 3 / Apollo 12
summary: Robotic precursor lander later visited and sampled by the Apollo 12 crew.

name: Mars Pathfinder
summary: Airbag landing in Ares Vallis that carried Sojourner, the first rover on Mars.

name: Mars Exploration Rover — Spirit
summary: Gusev crater rover that found hydrothermal silica in the Columbia Hills and ran for six years.

name: Mars Exploration Rover — Opportunity
summary: Meridiani Planum rover that found evidence of ancient salty water and drove 45.16 km.

name: InSight
summary: Geophysics station in Elysium Planitia that measured the interior of Mars with a seismometer.

name: Viking 1
summary: The first successful Mars lander, which operated as a weather station for more than six years.
